title: Dragon-Devouring Mage
altTitles: นักเวทผู้กลืนกินมังกร
description: Russel Raymond is the last successor of a fallen founding family and a cursed third-rate mage who was expelled from the academy. Forced to survive as a low-ranking mercenary, his life changes when his mother's memento, the Dragon's Heart, reacts to a dragon's heart in a museum. Given another chance, Russel regresses to his academy days with a new power and begins rewriting his fate. Determined to restore his family's honor, he sets out to become a powerful mage and uncover the mystery behind the dragon within him.
author: Ilhwang / Ramwoo
